title: Import with a mapping
purpose: Validate an exported results file against one analytical batch and save all valid rows as entered revisions only after confirming the preview.
summary: Import an instrument or LIMS export into this batch using a saved mapping that says which column holds what. Check the preview; nothing is saved until you confirm.

tasks.title: Import with a saved mapping
steps: Choose the [[Mapping profile]] and the results file.
For XLSX, enter the exact [[Worksheet name]]. For CSV/TSV, leave it blank.
Select [[Validate and preview]] and check What will be recorded and the preview rows.
Confirm the import. Every result is saved as entered, or none.

tasks.title: Fix a file or mapping that has errors
steps: Correct the source file or the mapping, then select [[Preview again]].

tasks.title: Create a mapping first
steps: If no mapping is offered, select [[New mapping]] and describe your file's columns.

good_to_know: A blank cell in a wide file is skipped. It is not ND and does not change an existing result.
The unit supplied by the file or mapping must match the test unit exactly. Nothing is converted.
The same file, mapping and worksheet cannot be imported twice into this batch.
After confirmation, staff can download the whole upload from the batch, including other worksheets in an XLSX workbook.
XLSX imports stored values, not display formatting. Use text timestamps and identifiers; formulas are refused.

sections.title: Access, context and tabs
paragraphs: Active internal staff with a laboratory role can read this workspace; clients cannot. Analysts manage mappings and import results. Admin includes analyst operational access; superuser status alone does not grant a laboratory role.

The page identifies Batch, exact method/version and Matrix. Staff without analyst access see Read only. An open or closed analytical batch can accept results; membership closure alone does not block entry.

items.label: Import results
items.description: Tab opens the standard fixed-column results-file workflow for this same batch.

items.label: Import with a mapping
items.description: Current tab uses an active saved mapping for long or wide CSV/TSV text or a selected XLSX worksheet.

items.label: New mapping
items.description: Shown when there are no active mappings; opens mapping creation. Existing inactive profiles cannot be selected for upload.

items.label: Mapping profile
items.description: Required active saved mapping. A profile selected through the link/query can be preselected; upload validation still requires an active available choice.

items.label: Results file (CSV, TSV or XLSX)
items.description: Required file, at most 1024 KiB (1 MiB), containing at most 2000 results and blank mapped cells combined. Use a filename with 1 to 200 printable characters and no directory path. CSV/TSV uses the mapping’s delimiter; a leading UTF-8 byte order mark is ignored for parsing but included in the file digest. XLSX uses the explicitly named worksheet and ignores the delimiter. Legacy XLS, XLSM, XLSB and ODS are refused.

items.label: Worksheet name
items.description: Required for XLSX: exact case-sensitive name of a visible worksheet, at most 31 characters. No active or first sheet is chosen automatically. A missing or unknown name reports up to 20 available visible worksheets and counts any others. Leave blank for CSV/TSV. This selection belongs to this upload; it does not change the saved mapping.

items.label: Validate and preview
items.description: Reads and validates without writing results. Mapped headers must occur exactly once; missing or duplicate mapped headers fail. Text records need the same width as the header. Missing worksheet cells are blank; nonblank cells beyond the header fail. Blank records are ignored. Preamble rows and unused columns are reported.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the analytical batch without importing.

sections.title: Result eligibility and quantities
paragraphs: Every imported sample/analyte must already be assigned to this batch, matched case-insensitively after trimming. No test or sample is created by import. A file cannot contain two populated results for the same sample/analyte. Unit is required explicitly and must exactly equal the test unit. Numeric results and reporting limits use exact decimals; result text up to 60 characters is preserved. ND is a non-detect, never zero. Comparison text, units within numeric values, thousands separators and lossy precision are rejected. Reporting limit and dilution must be positive; dilution allows at most four effective decimal places. Values below the applied reporting limit need at least one active qualifier or must be entered as ND. Qualifier codes must be active and exact.

Analysis start is required and must be no more than two minutes ahead of the server clock, not before receipt or the relevant preparation event. Local times without offsets use the laboratory zone; ambiguous/nonexistent daylight-saving times require an explicit ISO offset. Independent preparation requires an explicit eligible aliquot ID covering this sample and test, the configured preparation method, actual start, and analysis not before completion when recorded. Soil requires explicit wet/dry basis; optional 0–100% solids requires its reference, and neither result nor limit is converted. Non-soil rows reject wet/dry and solids metadata. Hold/reject samples cannot be saved as analytical results.

A submitted revision must be returned by a reviewer before replacement. Approved or returned results require a nonblank mapped reason; a draft replacement can use the standard recorded draft-revision reason. Every new entry is a new revision retaining prior evidence, not an overwrite. Preview does not approve results or validate QC/release.

sections.title: XLSX values and workbook limits
paragraphs: Use a plain XLSX values-only table. Headers, sample IDs, analytes, units, analysis timestamps and other text fields must be stored as text. Numeric cells are accepted for results, reporting limits, dilution factors, percent solids and prepared aliquot IDs. Timestamps must be text in the mapping’s declared format; Excel serial dates and typed date cells are not converted. Text retains its characters, including leading zeros. Numeric values retain their stored decimal text, not formatting such as extra displayed zeroes, percentages or dates.

The selected sheet must be visible. Hidden and filtered rows and columns are included. Formulas (even with cached results), error cells, booleans, typed dates and merged cells in the selected sheet are refused, including unused columns and preamble rows. Macro-enabled, encrypted, external-link, malformed or unsupported workbooks are refused. Use a separate values-only sheet and retain the original in the laboratory’s records.

Workbooks are limited to 200 ZIP members and 20 MiB expanded contents; selected worksheets to 10000 physical rows, 256 columns and 100000 stored cells. Shared strings are limited to 100000 entries; each cell text to 32767 characters. These are application resource limits, not laboratory rules. The 2000 result/blank-cell limit also applies. Split larger tables.

sections.title: Preview status and What will be recorded

items.label: Valid / Errors
items.description: Valid shows total results that passed and states nothing is saved yet. Any file or row error blocks the entire file. Fix the source or mapping and preview again; errors do not import the otherwise-valid rows.

items.label: Worksheet
items.description: Shown for XLSX. Identifies the selected sheet. All its rows and columns are read, including hidden or filtered ones; other worksheets are not imported.

items.label: Mapping
items.description: Profile name and layout used for this preview, plus delimiter for CSV/TSV only.

items.label: Mapping SHA-256
items.description: Digest of layout, delimiter and full mapping meaning, not name/notes. Display is shortened with full digest in its detail.

items.label: File SHA-256 (uploaded bytes)
items.description: Digest of bytes exactly uploaded, including any BOM and line-ending differences, displayed shortened with full detail.

items.label: Results
items.description: Counts of valid new results versus new revisions of existing results.

items.label: Original file
items.description: Confirmation saves the entire uploaded file, even when you import only one worksheet. Staff can download it from Import source files on the batch.

items.label: How the file is read
items.description: CSV/TSV uses UTF-8 with a leading BOM ignored. XLSX reads stored text and numeric values without applying cell display formats or calculating formulas. Digits already rounded by the workbook producer cannot be recovered. The digest covers all original uploaded bytes.

items.label: Rows above the header
items.description: Count of ignored preamble records, shown when nonzero.

items.label: Columns not mapped
items.description: Listed source headers that are present but not read; otherwise none.

items.label: Blank cells
items.description: Count of skipped wide-layout analyte cells. Empty cells are not ND and do not clear or change an existing result.

sections.title: Preview table
paragraphs: All error rows are shown first, followed by at most 100 valid rows; a message counts additional valid rows not displayed. The eventual import still includes all validated result rows.

items.label: Source
items.description: Source record number; wide layout includes the column. XLSX adds the selected worksheet name and uses physical worksheet row numbers, including blank rows. Retained on each result revision with the filename.

items.label: Sample
items.description: Laboratory sample ID read from the mapping.

items.label: Analyte
items.description: Resolved catalog analyte with the original file name/header when different.

items.label: Result as supplied
items.description: Original result text. Soil additionally shows Wet weight/Dry weight, optional solids percentage and its reference.

items.label: Unit
items.description: Explicit imported unit; never converted.

items.label: Reporting limit / Dilution
items.description: Applied limit in the test unit and explicit factor for this row.

items.label: Analysis start
items.description: Parsed local timestamp including zone when valid; otherwise original source text.

items.label: What will change
items.description: Row errors, New result, or next revision number with prior value/status retained. It does not delete the earlier revision.

sections.title: Blank cells (nothing imported)
paragraphs: Shows at most 50 skipped wide-layout cells and a count of further blanks. A file with no nonblank mapped results cannot be committed.

items.label: Row / Sample / Column
items.description: Source record, laboratory sample ID and mapped analyte column of each skipped cell.

items.label: Import result(s) as entered
items.description: Available to analysts only for an error-free preview. Revalidates the filename, uploaded bytes, selected worksheet, active profile, current target revisions, preparation evidence and assignments under locks. All rows, their revision history and audit metadata commit together, or none do. Success returns to the batch; review and submit there.

items.label: Start over
items.description: Leaves the valid preview and opens a new upload form for the same batch.

items.label: Preview again
items.description: Shown after an invalid preview or failed confirmation; opens a fresh upload form. Fix the original file or mapping first.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Leaves the preview and returns to the batch without writing results.

sections.title: Stale and repeated import rules
paragraphs: Confirmation refuses an inactive or removed profile, changed mapping meaning, changed file or worksheet selection, changed targeted latest revision or preparation dependency, and no longer valid result evidence. Refresh and preview again so the displayed plan reflects current records. A failed confirmation may display a re-parsed preview but does not silently commit it. Hidden confirmation data is validated; damaged or oversized payloads do not import anything.

The same raw file digest with the same mapping digest and worksheet cannot be imported twice into the same batch, even with a different filename; the previous actor/time are reported. Change the source meaningfully or correct results by hand. A mapping rename alone does not bypass repeated-file detection. Results are saved as entered with current user attribution, filename/worksheet/source row or column, mapping snapshot, file and mapping digests and audit metadata. The same confirmation saves the uploaded file with its import event. Staff can retrieve the original from the batch.

sections.title: Recorded calibration evidence
paragraphs: A calibration link is optional. It points to the recorded instrument evidence. The calibration record’s Calibration fit worksheet is for inspection only. Follow the laboratory’s procedure for method acceptance, source independence, sequencing and bracketing.

items.label: Calibration
items.description: Optional immutable instrument-reported curve for the result’s current batch, test and unit. In the single-result Enter result or Correct result form, choose it explicitly for every revision. Blank means Not linked and never carries an earlier link forward. The curve’s recorded time must precede or coincide with analysis.

items.label: Calibration verification
items.description: Optional current calibration-verification QC observation for the same batch, test and unit, used only with a selected curve. The observation must be at or after calibration; a closing check may follow sample analysis. Its label, exact observed text, true value, unit, time and identity are frozen with the revision.

items.label: Correction and independence
items.description: If a selected QC observation is superseded, submission, approval and release are held until a new result revision records current evidence. People who recorded the selected curve or check cannot independently review or release that result. Existing QC, holding-time and preservation gates still apply.

items.label: Where links are entered
items.description: Only the single-result form offers evidence choices. Grid entry, CSV/TSV/XLSX import and BOD5 bottle entry do not infer or carry calibration links. A later correction using those paths also leaves the new revision unlinked.

items.label: Stale form
items.description: If a result changed after the single-result form was opened, saving is refused and the input is kept. Reload to inspect the current revision before entering a correction.
